audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase; SHA-256 recomputed for every document listed (18 files in the inventory, all match). Entity: Arabia Insurance Cooperative Company on every cover 2022 to H1 2026 (the 2023 annual cover misspells COOPERATVE, a typographic variant of the same company; no rename or merger seen). Amounts are WHOLE SAR as printed, not thousands (unlike the other four insurers of this batch).
audit.method: Every primary statement in this issuer is an image page (zero text layer on pages 3-8 or 3-12 of nearly all files) or has only a partial text layer, so each transcribed set was rendered at 1.7x to 1.9x and read by eye: FY2022 (IFRS 4 original), FY2023, FY2024, FY2025, Q1 2023 (a whole-file zero-text scan flagged scanned_unread by the inventory), Q1/H1/9M 2025, Q1 2026, H1 2026. Every column passes the identities in tools/check_transcripts.py (BS equation; insurance service result = revenue + service expenses + net reinsurance; net insurance and investment result chain; profit before zakat chain; income after zakat = attributable + attributed to insurance operations; cash-flow sum and roll; Q1+Q2=H1 and H1+Q3=9M chains); five one-unit printed footing differences are declared, and 41 cross-filing differences are declared with both values and reasons.

value_correctness.summary: SAR (whole). Transcribed sets: FY2022 (IFRS 4), FY2023, FY2024, FY2025, Q1 2023, Q1/H1/9M 2025, Q1 2026, H1 2026. Findings: (1) IFRS 17 transition restated 2022: total assets 1,544,343,140 -> 1,383,530,679 (FY2023 annual) and 1,351,994,986 (Q1 2023 interim), equity 222,192,725 -> 242,803,670 / 243,136,823, net income attributable 8,277,592 -> 6,200,177, EPS 0.31 -> 0.21; the 31 Dec 2022 restated balance sheet and the 1 Jan 2022 opening balance sheet differ between the Q1 2023 interim and the FY2023 annual (declared). (2) FY2024 re-presented in the FY2025 annual: insurance service expenses -488,149,657 -> -489,729,796 (the 1,580,139 attributed to insurance operations is now inside insurance expenses), profit before zakat 41,127,744 -> 39,547,605, net income line 31,727,744 -> 30,147,605 (shareholders result unchanged), insurance contract liabilities 993,085,264 -> 1,001,933,463 and cash flow operating -18,597,175 -> -22,249,333; also Q1 and H1 2025 cash-flow comparatives shift by 710 and 206 in the 2026 filings. (3) The 9M 2025 income statement prints insurance service expenses as positive amounts (53,749,930 for 9M, 336,870,742 for Q3) with net reinsurance of -634,768,356 / -548,665,869; the chain foots as printed but the sign looks like a presentation error or a large reversal, and FY2025 then shows expenses -199,136,372 with net reinsurance -667,517,349: 9M and FY lines are therefore not additive by component and must be used only at the insurance service result level. (4) FY2025 is a loss: insurance revenue 851,122,253, insurance service result -15,531,468, net loss -45,181,301 (EPS -0.85) versus profit 30,147,605 in 2024; H1 2026 loss -26,741,259 (Q1 -14,804,458, Q2 -11,936,801) vs H1 2025 profit 9,574,470; total assets halved from 1,726,033,997 (Dec 2024) to 1,254,533,749 (Dec 2025) as reinsurance contract assets fell from 789,272,112 to 191,919,451. (5) The H1 2026 segment note p36 totals (assets 1,131,330,217, liabilities 586,665,582) differ from the primary balance sheet (1,121,281,246 / 576,616,611) by 10,048,971, equity identical: not reconciled. Seasonality: Q3 2025 is a near-zero quarter, so quarter values are not run-rate.
